title: SSC CPO Reasoning
summary: SSC CPO Paper I Reasoning past questions from 16 shifts, 2024 to 2025, five a day. Questions SSC asked again and the question types it keeps asking come first, ranked together by how often they were asked, then every other question.
note: Repeats are counted across the 16 SSC CPO Paper I shifts, June 2024 and December 2025, including questions SSC reprinted word for word. SSC writes fresh questions for almost every shift, so most of the order comes from question types (the rule a question tests). Figure-only questions are not grouped. Groups were found by a chapter-by-chapter reading (scripts/homework/REVIEW_BRIEF_SSC.md) and checked in the main session. Questions marked defective are left out.

Word that cannot be formed from the letters of a given word

Sum of two numbers multiplied by a number: the result
